narrative_type: Editorial reconstruction from checked-in reports; not a timestamped agent transcript.
time_basis: Playback seconds are presentation pacing, not experiment runtime.
source_policy: Allowlisted aggregate report extracts only. Hashes identify complete source files, not these excerpts. Raw outcomes and model binaries are excluded.

limitations: The 0.612858 score is public validation evidence, not a hidden-test result.
The full champion is a research ensemble; distillation into a smaller deployable model remains future work.
Some label-free slate corrections assume the full candidate slate is available at inference.

excerpt.leakage_note: The content/temporal correction is transductive but label-free: it uses the complete supplied evaluation impression slate and static video metadata, matching the official batch evaluator. Outcome priors, coverage membership, the user-neighbor graph, and the user-balanced tree use only the April 8-21 training block; the validation slate contributes identifiers but no outcomes. The neighbor graph uses training exposure overlap for similarity and other users' training outcomes for candidate estimates. The batch-slate tree is trained out of time on April 14-19, early-stopped on April 20-21, then refit; the user-balanced tree is fit through April 19 and early-stopped on April 20-21 before April 22-28 inference. No validation long_view, click, play time, or other outcome is read as a feature. Deployments that do not know the complete candidate slate must not use the transductive terms as written.

protocol.confirmation: 2022-04-22..2022-04-28, opened only by RCR after its all-metric screen pass.
protocol.hidden_outcomes: No 2022-04-29+ outcome field was parsed by any completed run.
protocol.promotion_gate: Improve primary, GAUC, and nDCG@5; then survive a predeclared 5% frozen-champion residual and four actual-user-ID folds.

totals.note: Trainer wall-seconds are summed across concurrent runs and are not end-to-end elapsed time. Process-level telemetry does not measure combined RAM across overlapping workers.

excerpt.recommendation: Keep the 0.612858057 champion. Retain RCR as the only validated backbone improvement, but do not blend it into the champion without a new source of complementary signal or a predeclared cross-fitted integration rule.

excerpt.zero_preferring_selection: alpha=0 unless a nonzero alpha gains >=0.0001 primary and strictly improves GAUC and nDCG@5

excerpt.notes: The checked-in manifest and validation export identify the frozen recipe. Large prerequisite model checkpoints remain untracked and are reproducible from the documented scripts. Use the guarded exporter exactly once for the final hidden split.
